voice.summary: Quiet Hours speaks the way a good lullaby sounds: slow, low and kind. It uses short sentences with plenty of room between them, never pushing the listener toward anything.
dos: Address the reader as 'you' and nothing more

taglines: Slow your breath, slow your thoughts
Ready whenever the day is not
boilerplate: Quiet Hours is a sleep app that guides a four-minute breathing wind-down on a 4-7-8 rhythm, helping people slow down before bed.
